## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Olesa de Montserrat, Spain. The listing gives its length as 1 – 1.5 hours, over a route of about 3 km. It starts at Aeri de Montserrat, C-55, 15, 08691 Monistrol de Montserrat, Barcelona, Spain. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Aeri de Montserrat cable car round-trip ticket (up & down). There is no live guide: the tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Discover the breathtaking beauty and rich heritage of Montserrat with a round-trip ticket for the Aeri de Montserrat cable car and self-guided audio tour.
>
> Ride the iconic cable car up Montserrat in just five minutes, traveling 1,350 meters at an average speed of 5 m/s. As you ascend inclines of up to 45%, enjoy spectacular panoramic views of the surrounding landscape and the monumental Rosary of the Virgin.
>
> Once at the top, explore Montserrat at your own pace with your audio guide. Discover the facade of the Benedictine monastery, founded in the 11th century, and learn about the sanctuary’s religious and cultural significance. Hear about the revered 12th-century sculpture of the Virgin of Montserrat and discover the history of the Escolania, one of Europe’s oldest music schools for children.
>
> Your audio guide will lead you through the key highlights of Montserrat, bringing its history, traditions, art, and religious heritage to life. With the freedom to pause and explore whenever you like, this experience combines the convenience of a round-trip cable car ticket with an informative self-guided tour of one of Catalonia’s most iconic destinations.
